identity: Leonard Mark Lewis: Elegy, commissioned Colton Nelson
findings: Composer's public score identifies alto saxophone and piano and commission by Colton Nelson.
Direct purchase page and one-page score preview are available from the composer.

The composer's 2019 Elegy: In Memoriam of the Emanuel Nine appears in a separate commission list. No source established that it is this Colton Nelson saxophone work, so neither its date nor subtitle is transferred.

evidence.claim: Alto/piano, commission and actual opening notation

score_observations: Opening 6/8 quarter=52, alto one-flat signature and piano four flats. Saxophone enters ppp on tied long notes after a piano introduction.
Long slurs develop into eighth-note lines and later sixteenths with upper-register notes. Quiet sustained entry, legato control and phrase pacing are concrete concerns in the viewed page.
No extended-technique signs appear on this page; full-work demands and range remain unknown.
gaps: Composition date, duration, movements, edition number and exact recording not verified.
Do not conflate with Emanuel Nine Elegy without a source connecting them.
